incidents.title: A kingdom finds its voice
incidents.description: Above Alubarna, Vivi fights to make her people hear her. Beneath the city, Luffy faces Crocodile. When the rain finally returns, the fighting falls silent.

incidents.title: The wings that carried hope
incidents.description: The clock tower hides a cannon aimed at the crowded square. Vivi reaches it, but the shell is still counting down. Pell carries it high above the city.

incidents.title: Behind the golden façade
incidents.description: In the oasis city of Rainbase, Crocodile's casino conceals the machinery of a rebellion. The crew's search for answers becomes a trap beneath Rain Dinners.

incidents.title: An answer without words
incidents.description: Vivi stays with the kingdom she loves. As the Going Merry sails away, the crew raises their marked arms: a quiet promise that distance cannot undo.

incidents.title: Where the desert journey begins
incidents.description: The Going Merry reaches Nanohana, Alabasta's busy port. The crew gathers supplies, Luffy crosses paths with Ace, and Vivi prepares to lead her friends inland.

incidents.title: The man who kept digging
incidents.description: Sand has overwhelmed the oasis. Toto keeps digging for water and refuses to give up on Yuba, even after the rebel army has moved to Katorea.

incidents.title: An oasis lost to the sand
incidents.description: Once a green city beside the Sandora River, Erumalu now stands abandoned. Its dry canals and empty streets show the crew what the drought has taken.

incidents.title: A rebellion on the move
incidents.description: After leaving Yuba, the rebel army establishes its base at Katorea. Koza leads the rebels toward Alubarna as Baroque Works drives the kingdom closer to war.
